questions.question_english: 100. What is the primary goal of the "Fiscal Consolidation" pathways recommended by Finance Commissions in India?
options_english: To increase total government public borrowing continuously without statutory policy limits

questions.question_english: 23. What is the primary economic implication of a persistent current account deficit (CAD) for an emerging market like India?

Automatic structural appreciation of the domestic currency in foreign exchange markets
Widespread deflationary pressures across domestic consumer goods and services sectors
Total elimination of the sovereign public debt burden and fiscal deficit challenges
questions.explanation_english: A persistent current account deficit (CAD) indicates that a country is importing more goods, services, and capital than it is exporting. For an emerging market like India, this leads to increased reliance on foreign capital inflows to bridge the gap in foreign exchange. This situation can create vulnerabilities in the economy, as it may lead to currency depreciation and increased external debt if not managed properly.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। लगातार चालू खाता घाटा (CAD) यह दर्शाता है कि एक देश वस्तुओं, सेवाओं और पूंजी का आयात अपने निर्यात से अधिक कर रहा है। एक उभरते बाजार जैसे भारत के लिए, यह विदेशी मुद्रा के अंतराल को संतुलित करने के लिए विदेशी पूंजी प्रवाह पर बढ़ती निर्भरता की ओर ले जाता है। यह स्थिति अर्थव्यवस्था में कमजोरियों को जन्म दे सकती है, क्योंकि यदि इसे ठीक से प्रबंधित नहीं किया गया तो यह मुद्रा के अवमूल्यन और बाहरी ऋण में वृद्धि का कारण बन सकती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Widespread deflationary pressures across domestic consumer goods and services sectors

questions.explanation_english: The Public Debt-to-GDP Ratio is a crucial indicator used to assess the sustainability of public debt in an economy.
